title: Sync Event Stream DOM and prune future rows on branch switch, redo, and backward date jumps

sections.what: Rebuild and prune #event-stream DOM whenever the active timeline branch changes, a turn is redone, or the game clock moves backward so visible rows and auto-persistence stay strictly aligned with (branch_id, time_ticks).
sections.why: timeline-bar.ts switchBranch(), timeline-view.ts Fork & Redo, event-stream.ts Redo, and sky-scape.ts _setExactDate currently leave stale future/other-branch DOM rows inside #event-stream, causing new past-tick turns to append below future turns and overwriting SQLite on the next auto-persist.
sections.how: Track active branch_id and fork_tick in StreamPersistence (static/js/stream/stream-persistence.ts) so persist() filters records to tick >= fork_tick on non-main branches and sends branch_id + from_tick to POST /api/stream/batch. Add syncToTimeline(branchId?, maxTick?) on StreamPersistence and pruneAfterTick(maxTick) on EventBus (static/js/event-stream.ts). Call syncToTimeline after /api/timeline/switch, /api/timeline/fork, and /api/timeline/redo in timeline-bar.ts, timeline-view.ts, and event-stream.ts, and call pruneAfterTick when _setExactDate in static/js/sky-scape.ts moves time_ticks backward.

acceptance.text: StreamPersistence.persist and restore pass active branch_id and only sync branch-owned rows after fork_tick
StreamPersistence.syncToTimeline(branchId, maxTick) reloads #event-stream from /api/stream?branch_id=...&tick_to=... (clearing DOM when empty) without triggering overwrite storms
EventBus.pruneAfterTick(maxTick) removes #event-stream turn cards and rows with tick > maxTick when rewinding clock date/time backward
Switching branches in timeline-bar.ts / timeline-view.ts, clicking Redo in event-stream.ts, and rewinding date in sky-scape.ts immediately update #event-stream to match current branch and tick

custom.browser_ui: Switching branches in #timeline-branch-bar, clicking Fork & Redo in #timeline-view or Redo on a turn card, or setting an earlier date in SkyScape immediately updates #event-stream so future/sibling-branch rows disappear and new actions append at the right tick.
